title: The Door We Haven’t Seen
premise: Aren can keep his morning round or offer an early collection, but not both. The visit becomes useful only when he and Daro learn what the washhouse actually needs its doorway for.
reading_premise: A pickup request has a time, but no one has walked the door. An honest refusal and one limited working trial may find a promise that fits.
